alt: Four CMF by Nothing Bluetooth speakers in white, orange, dark grey, and turquoise arranged together, each with a large circular speaker grille and small volume knob — their boxy rectangular shapes resembling milk cartons
credit: CMF by Nothing / Business Today India
story: CMF by Nothing launched its first-ever Bluetooth speakers on October 12, 2026 — the Speaker S ($59) and Speaker M ($109) — with a boxy rectangular design and gabled top so similar to dairy packaging that TechRadar, Yanko Design, and Business Today all independently led with the milk-carton comparison in their headlines.
why_funny: The entire press corps covering a premium audio launch independently agreed the design looked like something you'd find next to the 2% milk — and CMF apparently considers this a selling point.
